notes.title: Fixed sounds, saves, and more!
notes.notes:
[list]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/12360/discussions/0/4295942652154927084/]Added a GFWL save migration tool.[/url]
  If you migrated via the old method and experienced crashes, please use this tool.
[*]Fixed distorted audio of the players engine.
[*]Fixed crash when opening cheats menu or the guide.
[*]Fixed Steam Deck controller detection when the game is launched via the launcher.
[*]Fixed some controls not working when using a controller.
[*]Fixed some GFWL saves crashing the game.
[*]Reduced frequency of crashes when alt-tabbing.
[/list]

notes.title: Announcing FlatOut: Ultimate Carnage Collector's Edition!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952658/7af399c83528535ee610b177334669d86c824865.png[/img]

[list]
[*] The game is now Steam Deck Verified! ✅
[*] Removed Games for Windows LIVE DRM.
[*] Added Achievements.
[*] Added Czech, Hungarian, Polish, Russian, French, German, Italian, Spanish
[*] Fixed distorted audio of the players engine.
[*] Fixed crash when used with certain multi-monitor setups.
[*] Fixed other bugs, crashes, and improved loading times.

[*] The launcher is now optional, pressing play launches you directly in-game.
[/list]
- With ❤ from the ZOOM Platform Team!

[h3]Locating the Digital Goodies:[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Right click the game in your library
[*] Hover over "Manage"
[*] Then click "Browse local files"
[/olist]
[h3]Accessing the previous version of the game:[/h3]
If you wish, you may access the previous version of the game by selecting the "gfwl" branch in the "Betas" tab in properties.
Note that this version is not supported, and only exists for archival purposes. We will not provide support for this version of the game.

notes.title: Have You Played FlatOut: Ultimate Carnage?
notes.notes:
Have You Played? is an endless stream of game retrospectives. One a day, every day of the year, perhaps for all time.

FlatOut [Steam page] is one of my favourite games about cars wot go fast. It’s like the twisted metal wreckage of a collision between Carmageddon, Burnout and Destruction Derby, and manages to succeed as a vehicular combat physics playground and a competitive racing game. Ultimate Carnage is the best version of this brilliant crash ’em up.

notes.title: Pre-Purchase Now: FlatOut 3: Chaos & Destruction, 10% off
notes.notes:
FlatOut 3: Chaos & Destruction is now available for pre-purchase on Steam and is 10% off until release! FlatOut 3: Chaos & Destruction is also available as part of the FlatOut Complete Pack which contains all the previous FlatOut titles. Already own the other FlatOut titles? Extra copies of the FlatOut, FlatOut2 and FlatOut: Ultimate Carnage in the Complete Pack can be gifted to friends!

FlatOut 3: Chaos & Destruction is demolition racing at its extreme. Real world physics with 9 different game modes, and over 47 different vehicles available. Players may choose to race, smash and destroy their opponents in a wide variety of online and offline options.
